wave.linear_normalization: Scale |v_L| so its pre-sponge maximum equals the maximum of |v_1| in the shared pre-sponge radial interval. This affects display only, not growth-rate diagnostics.
wave.field_phase_definition: phi=beta*theta-omega*t=0 in the saved phase convention; panel b is the fundamental contribution 2 Re(v_1 exp(i phi)).
wave.field_projection: Every native R node in window; barycentric interpolation from N+1=41 Chebyshev nodes to 161 display z nodes. No radial interpolation or smoothing.
wave.coefficient_convention: Scaled azimuthal coefficients v_j; physical dimensionless velocity perturbation is R times the reconstructed coefficient.
